finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker could input a file name that includes shell metacharacters or commands.
finding.assumptions: The program does not sanitize or validate the input file name before using it in the open() function.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked whether the user-supplied file name is passed to any function that executes a shell command or creates a system command string. The only sink is policeStationFile.open(fileName), which opens a file and does not invoke a shell. No command execution or concatenation with shell metacharacters occurs. Therefore, the alleged OS Command Injection does not exist.
